rows.ARS:
Deep pink Polyantha.
Exhibition name: Lovely Fairy
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Hette Spek (Netherlands, 1990).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 1994 as 'Lovely Fairy'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild to strong, fruity fragrance. 21 to 36 petals. Average diameter 1.25". Small, very double, in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 16" to 4' (40 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b through 10b. Can be used for ground cover. Shade tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
